API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser ManagementGroup Resource Update Group
Group Resource Update Group
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/groups/:groupId

Updates an existing group based on the specified ID.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
groupId
int32
REQUIRED

Group ID

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Group information

id
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the group

name
string
REQUIRED

Group name

idpId
int64

Unique identifier for the identity provider (IdP)

comments
string

Additional information about the group

isSystemDefined
boolean

System-defined group

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
500

Group updated successfully

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
